text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali chaired a ceremony at the occasion of the Sports Day. Ben Ali called for women to do more sports activities.

- President Ben Ali received South African Deputy President Thabo Mbeki. The two countries want to boost their economic cooperation and discussed the Middle East peace process and crisis in the African continent.
- Ministers are touring the country to chair RCD's ruling party grassroots congresses.
